items.title: Frozen Russian assets in Switzerland reportedly exceed $10 billion
items.summary: Bloomberg reportedly puts the value of Russian assets frozen in Switzerland above $10 billion, reflecting additional asset freezes and an increase in the value of some gold holdings.

items.title: Russia reports arrest over alleged attack on regional official
items.summary: Russia's Federal Security Service announced the detention of a suspect in an alleged attack on an official in Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia region. Russian authorities allege Ukrainian involvement and say the official was unharmed. The allegations have not been independently verified.

items.title: Russia claims 305 Ukrainian drones intercepted overnight
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry reported intercepting 305 Ukrainian drones across Russian regions overnight. The nationwide figure has not been independently verified.

items.title: Boris Johnson advocates sending European troops to Ukraine
items.summary: Former British Prime Minister Boris Johnson reportedly advocated deploying European troops to Ukraine in a Sky News interview, arguing that NATO is stronger than Russia. His remarks do not represent an announced government deployment decision.

items.title: Russian-appointed Donetsk authorities report civilian injuries
items.summary: Russian-appointed authorities in occupied Donetsk region reported civilian injuries from alleged Ukrainian attacks over the preceding day, including incidents involving civilian vehicles. The accounts have not been independently verified.
